# Kubernetes at the edge

Every capitalised term below sits somewhere the rule must not read.

The team ran `Kubernetes` from a shell alias for a year.

The runbook lives at https://Kubernetes.example.com/runbook and nobody reads it.

- Step through the queue before the batch window closes.
- Modify the record only after the lock clears.
- Create the namespace, then hand it over.

**Answer first.** **This** is what the splitter used to break on.
